description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

Create N purchase orders from an approved Purchase Request. Validation and budget checks are hard gates: if any fails, zero POs are created. POs are first created in Draft and committed, then encumbrance is booked and they are promoted to Approved. If encumbrance booking fails, the POs are left in Draft (label Errored) and a non-fatal `ENCUMBRANCE_FAILED` entry is returned in the top-level `warnings` array (HTTP 201) rather than failing the request; the caller must cancel/delete those Draft POs before re-submitting the same PR (a re-submit returns 409 DUPLICATE_PURCHASE_REQUEST while they exist). When the entity admin setting `autoIssueOnPromotion` is true, approved POs are also transitioned to Issued — requires PO_CREATOR and PO_ISSUER claims. If issue fails after approval commits, the POs remain Approved and a non-fatal `AUTO_ISSUE_FAILED` warning is returned. The response `status` field reflects the final PO status (Draft, Approved, or Issued).

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

Deep-copy an existing Purchase Order (header, line items, GL splits, selected attachments) into a new Draft PO. Comments are not copied. Supply attachmentIds to select which attachments to copy; an empty array copies none. Attachments are duplicated via S3 server-side copy; if an individual S3 copy fails the attachment row is soft-deleted and the rest of the copy succeeds. The new PO gets a fresh PO number, today's date, the current fiscal year/period, status = Draft, source = Manual. Financial tracking amounts and state-transition timestamps are reset. Copy is allowed from any source PO status.
